Optorun.why: Optical thin-film deposition equipment maker whose optical-communications orders are driven by optical transceiver makers' AI data-center build-out (FY12/2026 optical communications order forecast raised to JPY 20bn).
Optorun.evidence: Orders for optical communications-related products increased ninefold YoY due to increased inquiries from optical transceiver-related companies ... The transition of optical transceivers to 800G/1.6T is driving early demand for optical thin-film and functional-film equipment (Q2 FY12/2026 results briefing, 08-07-2026).

players.product: Optical thin-film deposition equipment for data-center optical transceivers: vapor deposition (OTFC-1300 / SPOC-1300) for AR/HR and WDM/TFF filter films on lasers, optical filters and modules; sputtering (OWLS-1800 / SPOC-S-1200) for SiPh PIC, TFLN and optical-engine films; ALD and etching systems

quarterly_data.signal: TDnet notice (Japanese): the board resolved on September 28, 2026 to invest in Optorun India Private Limited (Chennai, Tamil Nadu), established September 1, 2026 and 90% owned by Optorun (10% FTO). Purpose: with local production of optical-related products expanding in India, strengthen customer service and expand sales to customers there; local manufacturing of Optorun equipment and parts is in view for the future. Business: manufacture and sale of optical thin-film and vacuum deposition equipment, customer service, parts processing and sales; Optorun plans to sell deposition equipment to the subsidiary and entrust maintenance services to it. Company: impact on FY12/2026 consolidated results is minor.
